messages.subject: How to select smooth method?
parts:
Hi,

I try to see if I can select the smooth method. But it seems that the
two plots are different. Does anybody have the ggplot code that can
reproduce the "plot" result? Thanks!

library(ggplot2)
x=1:100
dfr=data.frame(x, y=x+rnorm(100,0,100))

result=loess(y~x, dfr, span=.8)
pred_y=predict(result, dfr$x)
png('main1.png')
plot(dfr$x, pred_y, ylim=c(0,100))
dev.off()

png('main2.png')
qplot(x, y, data=dfr)+stat_smooth(method='loess', span=.8)+ylim(0,100)
dev.off()


--
Regards,
Peng

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: How to select smooth method?
parts:
The problem is that ylim() will drop all the data points outside the range, and then the loess gets calculated on that. To avoid this, use coord_cartesian instead:

x <-1:100
dfr <-data.frame(x, y=x+rnorm(100,0,100))
qplot(x, y, data=dfr) + stat_smooth(method='loess', span=.8) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,100))
